title: This Totally Free App Can Free Up Space on Your Mac

claims.claim: Purge, Mac sabit diskindeki alanin ne taraftan harcandigini gosteren tamamen ucretsiz ve acik kaynakli bir uygulamadir.

evidence.quote: This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive
This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive and offers a few specific ways to free it up.

claims.claim: Purge uygulamasi reklamsizdir ve ek satis sunmaz.

evidence.quote: There are no ads or upsells.
Even better: There are no ads or upsells.

claims.claim: Purge, macOS 27'deki Apple Intelligence cevirdisi modellerini silebilir.
Apple Intelligence modellerinin silinmesi 10 GB'tan fazla alan bosaltabilir.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Purge, dosyaları dogrudan silmek yerine Copete gonderir.

evidence.quote: Finally, Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright
Finally, Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright, so you can always recover them if something breaks.

claims.claim: Purge; sistem dosyalarini ve kisisel belgeleri asla silmez.

evidence.quote: There's also a list of things it will never touch, including crucial system files and your own documents.

claims.claim: Uygulama kalintisi temizleme araci, onceden silinmis uygulamalarin biraktigi artık verileri gosterir ve temizler.

evidence.quote: Speaking of that, there's also a tool that shows leftover data from applications you've already deleted.

Speaking of that, there's also a tool that shows leftover data from applications you've already deleted. In my case, it was several gigabytes, all basically wasted. I highly recommend checking this section and deleting anything large that you're confident you won't use again.

claims.claim: macOS 27 surumunde Apple Intelligence ozelliklerini tamamen devre disi birakmaya yarayan bir secenek bulunmaktadir.

evidence.quote: Apple removed the toggle in macOS 27 that lets you disable them altogether.
